findings.title: A failed 'Add entry' save clears the typed journal text
findings.expected: When the save fails, the error shows and the typed entry text stays in the box so the user can try again
findings.actual: The error 'Injected 500' shows but the Entry textarea is emptied. addEntry() calls entryForm.reset() in its finally block, so the reset runs on failure too and the user's text is lost
